Name: Spouse Patio Cobblestone Paths
Author: pluviophist
Description:
[center][font=Times New Roman][size=4]I've always loved the look of the cobblestone from the spouse patio, and wished that I could use it as my own pathing. Well now you can![/size][/font][/center]
[line]

[left][font=Times New Roman]There is a [b][color=#ffd966]CP [Content Patcher][/color] [/b]version, and an [b][color=#ffd966]AT [Alternative Textures] [/color][/b]version. [/font][/left]
[left][/left]
[left][font=Times New Roman]The [b]CP [/b]version will replace the default cobblestone path texture, and should be configured to match any recolors you may be using. It is [u][b][color=#cc0000]not[/color] [/b]compatible with any other mod that [b]changes the texture[/b] of the [b]cobblestone path[/b][/u], so make sure you check your mods [i]before [/i]reporting any issues.[/font][/left]
[left][/left]
[left][font=Times New Roman]The [b]AT [/b]version will provide an additional texture to the cobblestone path which can be changed using the paint bucket sold by Robin. There are multiple versions, so only download the one that matches your recolor.[/font][/left]
[left][/left]
[left][font=Times New Roman]*[b]Something to note[/b]* This path was only really made to work on short grass, and might look a little funny on dirt, sand, thick grass, etc. But feel free to use it however you wish![/font][/left]
[center][line]
[/center]
[center][/center]
[font=Times New Roman][color=#6fa8dc][size=3]✿[b] Config Options:[/b][/size][/color][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Times New Roman]"Pack" : "Vanilla, VPR, Starblue, Earthy" - Select which recolor you are using. Defaults to vanilla.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman]"VPR Fall Variant" : "Orange, Green" - For those that are using VPR, select which grass variant you are using in the fall.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman]"Starblue Spring Variant" : "Green, Blue" -  For those that are using Starblue, select which grass variant you are using in the spring.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][b]If your preferred recolor isn't available, let me know. I'll do my best to include as many as possible[/b] (▰˘◡˘▰)[/font][/*]
[/list]
[font=Times New Roman][color=#6aa84f]✿[b] Installation:[/b][/color][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Times New Roman]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] [and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] if using the AT version][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098?tab=description]Generic Mod Config[/url]﻿ [Optional, but makes configuration easier]﻿﻿[/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman]Download this mod[/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman]Unzip the mod into your Stardew Valley "Mods/" folder[/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman]Run the game using SMAPI[/font][/*]
[/list]
[list]
[*][font=Times New Roman]To uninstall, delete this mod from Mods folder[/font][/*]
[/list]
[font=Times New Roman]✿ [b]Enjoy the mod, and please let me know if you come across any issues[/b]. ฅ(^•ﻌ•^ฅ) ♡[/font]

[font=Times New Roman]Mods Used in Screenshots[/font]
[list]
[*][font=Times New Roman]Map/Foliage Recolor: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn[/url] [ + VPR Expanded in optional files ], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4966]Stardew Foliage Redone[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15033]Anette's Clover Grass[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolor[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21085]Starblue Valley[/url][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman]﻿Reshade: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1213]Natural Color[/url][/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15079?tab=description]Better Water[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8897]Visible Fish[/url][/font][/*]
[/list]
